# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 platform release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Skia m152 with Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and broad runtime reliability fixes. The release improves native assets and symbol packages, eliminates several lifetime bugs, and reduces allocation and lookup costs in graphics and text paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m152** — The bundled renderer receives the m152 release and servicing updates, including the Chrome GlyphData fix. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite and asynchronous pixel-read APIs** — Adds Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn plus backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support on SKImage and SKSurface. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — The SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is again produced and available for Vulkan integrations. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object lifetime is safer** — Fixes root source data for pixmap subsets and region iterators, releases failed raster image allocations, and disposes a replaced runtime-effect uniform buffer. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Graphics and shaping paths reduce overhead** — SKData saving, encoded-text access, uniform lookup, native-handle registration, four-byte tag conversion, and HarfBuzz feature shaping avoid unnecessary copies or allocations. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Native packages and symbols improve across platforms** — Apple symbol packages are generated during packing, Android symbols use deterministic identities, and Nano Server uses FreeType for font support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

HarfBuzzSharp shaping avoids a defensive feature-array copy, reducing allocation overhead for repeated shaping calls.
